{"script":"#!/bin/bash

# Capture environment variables relevant to executable lookup
env | grep -E '^(PATH|LD_LIBRARY_PATH|MANPATH|SHELL)=' > env_snapshot.txt 2>/dev/null || true

# Search the system for executables named "npm"
{ command -v -a npm 2>/dev/null || true; which -a npm 2>/dev/null || true; find / -path /proc -prune -o -path /sys -prune -o -path /dev -prune -o -type f -name npm -executable -print 2>/dev/null || true; } | sed '/^\s*$/d' | sort -u > found_paths.txt || true

# For each discovered path, run it with --version and capture stdout/stderr
> npm_version.txt
while IFS= read -r p; do
  printf '=== %s ===\n' "$p" >> npm_version.txt
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then
    rc=0
    output=$("$p" --version 2>&1) || rc=$?
    printf '%s\nEXIT_CODE:%s\n' "$output" "$rc" >> npm_version.txt
  else
    printf 'NOT_EXECUTABLE\nEXIT_CODE:127\n' >> npm_version.txt
  fi
done < found_paths.txt

# Compare paths with outputs to check for valid version strings
> consistency_check.txt
installed=0
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if [ -x "$p" ]; then
    rc=0
    output=$("$p" --version 2>&1) || rc=$?
    first_line=$(printf '%s' "$output" | head -n1)
    if printf '%s' "$first_line" | grep -Eq '^[vV]?[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+){1,}'; then
      echo "$p: valid: $first_line" >> consistency_check.txt
      installed=1
    else
      echo "$p: invalid: $first_line" >> consistency_check.txt
    fi
  else
    echo "$p: not_executable" >> consistency_check.txt
  fi
done < found_paths.txt

# Combine files into evidence bundle
{
  printf '--- env_snapshot.txt ---\n'
  cat env_snapshot.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '\n--- found_paths.txt ---\n'
  cat found_paths.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '\n--- npm_version.txt ---\n'
  cat npm_version.txt 2>/dev/null || true
  printf '\n--- consistency_check.txt ---\n'
  cat consistency_check.txt 2>/dev/null || true
} > evidence_bundle.txt

# Print final decision (single word: yes or no)
if [ "$installed" -eq 1 ]; then
  echo yes
else
  echo no
fi
"}
